prompt:
A music-video still, 16:9, at night in a bare 1920s tenement kitchen lit by a single naked bulb hanging overhead, hard light from above and black shadows under everything. The camera sits at tabletop height on a wide 24mm lens. A robber called CRIMSON leans across a scrubbed pine table into the lens, holding up a fork with one single baked bean on it, while his other gloved hand counts off on two fingers. Beside him is an opened tin, empty. His crimson hand-knitted rib-wool balaclava covers his head and neck, smooth unbroken knit where the face would be, a cream ring chain-stitched round it, a small rounded red felt triangle high over his right eye, on the left of the picture, and a grey fedora on top. He wears a charcoal pinstripe double-breasted suit, collar up, black leather gloves. Pinned to the cracked plaster behind him is a rent demand with a big red stamp, its print blurred and unreadable.

Thanks.
